{{DISPLAYTITLE:''I Choose You!'' trilogy}} [[File:Ash and Pikachu M20.png|thumb|250px|[[Ash Ketchum (M20)|Ash]] and [[Ash's Pikachu (M20)|his Pikachu]] in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]]] The {{pkmn|movie}} trilogy consisting of ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', ''[[M21|The Power of Us]]'', and ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'', along with the special tie-in episode ''[[JNS05|The Distant Blue Sky]]'', features an alternate version of the characters and world from {{aniseries|PTS}}, establishing its own separate [[canon]]. As part of the [[Pokémon movie]]s and [[List of animated series specials|animated series specials]], it is not considered directly part of ''Pokémon the Series'', though it is closely related. During the Pokémon Panel at San Diego Comic-Con in 2023, the trilogy is described as "the cinematic universe that [[Pokémon]] started with ''Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!''.""[https://youtu.be/IdZPeSiiVxE?t=1015 Pokémon Panel at San Diego Comic-Con 2023]." The Official Pokémon YouTube channel. ''YouTube''. ==Plot== As with {{aniseries|PTS}}, the movie trilogy follows [[Ash Ketchum (M20)|Ash]] as the central character. His story begins very similar to the {{Ash}} of the animated series, oversleeping on his tenth birthday and ending up with a stubborn [[Ash's Pikachu (M20)|Pikachu]] as his {{pkmn2|first partner}} that goes on to be his best friend. After catching some of the same {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} as his animated series counterpart, Ash's story takes a different path leading him to meet a variety of different people and Pokémon on his own adventures. ==List of movies== {| class="roundtable c" style="background: #{{Pokémon color}}; border: 3px solid #{{Pokémon color dark}}; width: 100%" |- style="background:#{{Pokémon color light}}" ! ''Pocket Monsters: The Distant Blue Sky'' | December 23, 2022 |- | colspan="6" class="l" | '''Summary:''' Ash and Pikachu are doing what they love as they travel to different places. But when Ash’s mom asks to meet at a nearby Pokémon Center, he heads out right away—his dad will be there, too! On the way, Ash befriends a boy named Sunny, who eventually leads him to a berry patch near a house. There, Ash meets a man and woman who reveal that Sunny is their son who passed away a year ago. Ash returns Sunny’s hat to them, then helps Sunny pet Pikachu before they part ways. At the Pokémon Center, Ash’s dad has already departed, but he left Ash a present—a brand-new hat! |} ==References== {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Animation]] [[it:Trilogia di Scelgo te!]]
